title: Schedule Appointment
description: Check our availability or schedule your appointment here: Our Scheduler is also Mobile Friendly ! ON SERVICE PAGE, SCROLL DOWN TO SEE ALL THE APPOINTMENT…
html:
We use this money that you donate to help individuals that are going through a very difficult financial time and so desperately need help and healing.  These individuals usually don't even have transportation to come to our office or don't have a computer to even do virtual appointments.  

Another area we use the money that you donate is for travel expenses so we can go and teach what the Lord has shown us about healing to churches, ministries and interested groups

We are not a 501-C3 (we are an LLC) so we are sorry but your generous donations are not deductible.
​Thank you for Donating and God Bless you for your support.
